title: Hands-on with SA80 replacement challengers🎯 - Military & War News
text:
BDT is one of several companies trying to convince MOD officials that theirs is the perfect choice to replace the SA80 L85, the primary weapon system for the vast majority of UK service personnel.
Sian Grzeszczyk Melbourne was granted exclusive access to try out two possible contenders, the Beretta NARP (New Assault Rifle Platform) and the Sako AR-15-style rifle.
